question.text: Which one of the following is the correct statement?

options.text: Boric acid is a protonic acid.

Both  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math>  ions act as oxidising agent in aqueous solution.

Hydrogen bonding in <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> gives it a layered structure.

<math><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">E</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  imparts blue colour to the burner flamer.

solution.text:
(i) It is a weak monobasic acid soluble in water and in aqueous solution boron atom completes its octet by accepting OH– from water molecules:
BOH3+2H2O→BOH4-+ H3O+
(ii) Only Tl3+ acts as an oxidising agent on account of inert pair effect.
(iii) In the solid state, the BOH3 units are hydrogen bonded together into two dimensional
sheets with almost hexagonal symmetry.

(iv) BOEt3 imparts green colour to the burner flame.
